caption: The drawing depicts a single standing figure resembling a stylized human form. The figure is brown with subtle variations in shading, suggesting a material with a slightly reflective or polished surface. It stands upright with legs together and arms held closely to the sides of the body. The head is rounded with a short, straight hairstyle ending just above the shoulders. The facial features are minimal, including a simple nose and two vertical lines for eyes. The background is plain and a light beige or off-white color, providing no additional context or objects. The composition centers the figure on the page, and the artist's signature and a small notation can be seen in the lower right corner.
title: Wooden Doll
